name: Perplexity
tagline: AI answer engine with cited sources
description: Perplexity is an AI answer engine that searches the web and shows the sources behind an answer, so you can open and check them.
features: Image generation and limited video generation on Pro
Access to several advanced models on Pro
useCases: Quick research where you want sources
Getting oriented on an unfamiliar topic
Finding pages to read in full
strengths: Paid Pro tier adds extended Pro Search and file uploads
limitations: A summary can still misread a source, so open the links for anything important
